current.name: Bowman
current.description: Fast enough to outpace slow towers, with decent health for its era. A versatile Bronze Age attacker.

current.name: Cargo
current.description: A heavy transport that deploys three Musketeers on death. Takes four slots but delivers a fearsome payload.

current.name: Cart
current.description: A carrier that fills three slots but releases five Clubmen on death. Hard to stop once rolling.

current.name: Chariot
current.description: The fastest Bronze Age unit, charging through defenses before they can react. Light armor but hard to intercept.

current.name: Clubman
current.description: A basic melee brawler that takes up extra wave capacity. Stronger than a Slave but equally slow.

current.name: Condotteri
current.description: A battle-hardened mercenary with above-average health and good speed. Reliable all-rounder of the medieval era.

current.name: Crusader
current.description: A well-rounded holy warrior with solid armor and decent speed. The backbone of medieval assaults.

current.name: Dragoon
current.description: Mounted gunner combining speed with solid armor. A well-rounded attacker that hits hard and moves fast.

current.name: Drone
current.description: A fast and agile flying unit with light armor. Difficult to hit but vulnerable to area damage.

current.name: Handgunner
current.description: Early gunpowder unit combining strong armor with high speed. Blends firepower with surprising mobility.

current.name: Helicopter
current.description: The fastest modern unit, deploying Soldiers on crash. Weak armor but nearly impossible to intercept.

current.name: Light Horseman
current.description: Swift cavalry that outpaces most tower fire. Fragile but nearly impossible to intercept.

current.name: Heavy Horseman
current.description: Heavily armored cavalry that shrugs off most damage. Slow but nearly unstoppable.

current.name: Knight
current.description: Encased in full plate armor, the Knight absorbs enormous punishment. Takes two slots but is extremely hard to bring down.

current.name: Large Cart
current.description: A massive carrier that deploys three Pikeneers on destruction. Four slots but delivers a dangerous payload.

current.name: Legionary
current.description: Rome's elite infantry with excellent armor and methodical advance. Relentless and hard to stop.

current.name: Mech Warrior
current.description: A two-slot combat mech with heavy armor that releases Special Ops on destruction. The pinnacle of future warfare.

current.name: Motorbike
current.description: Blazing fast reconnaissance unit that tears through defenses at top speed. Light armor compensated by sheer velocity.

current.name: Musketeer
current.description: Well-armored gunner that advances steadily under fire. Good balance of health, speed, and durability.

current.name: Ninja
current.description: The fastest Renaissance unit, slipping through gaps before towers can respond. Low armor but nearly impossible to catch.

current.name: Pikeneer
current.description: Disciplined spearman who moves quickly in tight formation. Low damage but relentless in numbers.

current.name: Samurai
current.description: An extremely fast duelist who darts past slow defenses. Less armored than Western knights but far quicker.

current.name: Scout
current.description: Fast and fragile, dashes through defenses before towers can react. Best used in large swarms.

current.name: Siege Ram
current.description: A slow carrier that carries Crusaders and deals massive damage. Three slots of nearly unstoppable force.

current.name: Siege Tank
current.description: Massively armored siege vehicle with near-impenetrable defense. Slow but almost impossible to destroy.

current.name: Slave
current.description: Weak and expendable, sent in swarms to overwhelm defenses. Costs almost nothing to field.

current.name: Small Tank
current.description: Compact armored vehicle with exceptional armor that shrugs off light fire. Slow but nearly immune to most damage.

current.name: Soldier
current.description: Industrial-era infantry with solid health and armor. The dependable backbone of modern assaults.

current.name: Special Ops
current.description: Elite special forces with advanced armor and tactical precision. Balanced speed and durability.

current.name: Swordman
current.description: Well-armored melee fighter with steady movement. A dependable all-purpose attacker.

current.name: The General
current.description: Supreme commander with devastating power and near-impenetrable armor. A wave-filling behemoth of modern warfare.

current.name: The King
current.description: A legendary ruler who fills an entire wave with impossible health and crushing damage. Bring your best defenses.

current.name: The Swordmaster
current.description: An ancient legend who fills an entire wave alone. Enormous health and damage that no single tower can handle.

current.name: Transporter
current.description: A hulking carrier that deploys eight Soldiers on death. Takes ten slots but delivers a full squad.

current.name: Warrior
current.description: Reliable all-rounder with basic armor and decent health. A solid first-era attacker.
